render_must_prove.non_static_visual_progression: The rendered preview must show visual change across the timeline — duplicate frame ratio must be below 0.85 or justified by explicit still-scene contract
render_must_prove.valid_frame_sampling: Frames must be sampled at regular intervals across the full timeline duration
render_must_prove.useful_contact_sheet: The contact sheet must show visually distinct frames that prove timeline progression
render_must_prove.canonical_preview_path: All preview outputs must use the canonical path output/preview/ (singular), not output/previews/ (plural)
